name: ring-ms90
cmd: GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 200 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 90000 --only ring_leader_election --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; s=$?; grep -E 'join (td|engine|meters|end|pool)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-300 | tail -c 9000; exit $s
